title: resiLIR HCP: A self-guided digital resilience intervention for healthcare professionals focusing on self-care and self-compassion – A randomized controlled trial

abstract_extraction.primary_outcome: resilience operationalized as time-varying stressor reactivity
abstract_extraction.direction_summary: No difference in resilience (stressor reactivity) in ITT analyses, although per-protocol analyses showed significant effects at post-intervention.
abstract_extraction.evidence: ITT analyses did not reveal any significant effects, neither for the primary outcome nor secondary outcomes after adjusting for multiple testing.

body_extraction.direction_summary: No difference in resilience (stressor reactivity score) between the intervention and control groups in ITT analysis, although it improved in per-protocol analysis.
body_extraction.evidence: the corresponding ITT analysis did not indicate a significant overall group × time interaction (b = −0.10, 95% CI [−0.28, 0.08], p = .261)

paper_type.detail: abstract says empirical, body says empirical

direction_agreement.detail: abstract: no difference | results: no difference
